era: 2026 : Phase 21 收官整合——Protreptic 主库的第二次方法人格入库（先例 H-P23F-001）。这是一个'方法人格'而非血肉人物：它把 Phase 21 十七批入库（库 1282→1452 模式，17 位人物：从莲花生、奥罗宾多、迈蒙尼德、赫茨尔、苏莱曼、斯宾诺莎、麦克林托克、屠呦呦、南丁格尔、富兰克林(女)、瓦特、福特、松下幸之助、本田宗一郎、司马光、梁启超、王国维到顾颉刚）所依赖的那套跨期挖掘与整合方法论本身，当作本期的最后一位'人物'来挖掘——跨文明互文、双语对生、并行岗卡、收官审计、悬空清零、场景锚定、载荷五件套、语义全等快照、漂移记账、收官复盘，十法合观即是'多文明知识体系如何在并行扩张中保持一张网'的完整答案；其'生平'由 Phase 21 的真实提交链构成（8-12 分钟一批的 merge 节奏、13/13→50/50 的断言代际增长、双 sha256 与三快照制度），其'师承'是 H-P23F-001 的十法在本期验证与演化的直接后代
era_en: 2026: the Phase 24 final integration—the second method-persona entered into the Protreptic main library (after H-P23F-001). A 'method-persona' rather than a flesh-and-blood figure: it mines, as this campaign's last 'person,' the cross-campaign methodology of mining and integration that carried Phase 21's seventeen merges (the library from 1,282 to 1,452 modes; seventeen figures from Padmasambhava, Aurobindo, Maimonides, Herzl, Suleiman, Spinoza, McClintock, Tu Youyou, Nightingale, Rosalind Franklin, Watt, Ford, Matsushita, Honda, Sima Guang, Liang Qichao and Wang Guowei to Gu Jiegang)—cross-civilization intertext, bilingual co-genesis, parallel post-cards, the closing audit, dangling-reference zeroing, scenario anchoring, the five-piece payload, semantic-identity snapshots, the drift ledger, and the closing retrospective; ten methods together answer 'how a multi-civilization knowledge system stays one web while expanding in parallel.' Its 'life' is Phase 21's real commit chain (a merge every eight to twelve minutes; assertions growing 13/13→50/50 across generations; the twin-sha256 and three-snapshot institutions), and its 'lineage' runs directly from H-P23F-001's ten methods, verified and evolved in this campaign
school: 知识体系挖掘工程学派 / '跨文明一张网'的整合传统 / Phase 21 收官方法论 / 方法人格谱系第二代
historical_significance: Phase24收尾整合（H-P24F-001）是 Protreptic 知识体系对自身生产过程的第二次自反性收编：当 Phase 21 以 8-12 分钟一批的节奏把 17 位人物、170 条模式并入主库时，真正值得挖掘的'独特思维'不是任何单一位人物的方法，而是让六个文明圈的产出并行入网而不互相撕裂的那套方法论。它的历史意义有三重。其一，证明'并行'与'一张网'可以兼得：跨文明互文法强制每次挖掘至少一条跨圈引用，悬空清零法保证每条引用可指认——密度与可靠性同时在线。其二，证明'快'与'双语'可以兼得：双语对生法使 8-12 分钟一批的节奏里 zh/en 逐条配对始终成立——速度不靠牺牲对生获得，靠接口恒定获得。其三，把'方法论的代际'制度化：与 P23F 十法逐条对照、断言清单代际增长（13/13→50/50）、缺陷形态免疫跨期生效——复盘不再是仪式而是可继承的资产
historical_significance_en: The Phase 24 final integration (H-P24F-001) is the Protreptic knowledge system's second reflexive incorporation of its own production: when Phase 21 merged seventeen figures and 170 modes at a batch every eight to twelve minutes, the 'unique thinking' worth mining was not any single figure's method but the methodology that let six civilizations' outputs enter one web in parallel without tearing it. Its significance is threefold. First, that 'parallel' and 'one web' can coexist: the cross-civilization intertext method forces at least one cross-circle reference per mining pass, the dangling-zeroing method makes every reference resolvable—density and reliability online together. Second, that 'fast' and 'bilingual' can coexist: bilingual co-genesis keeps the zh/en pairs true even at a batch every eight to twelve minutes—speed bought not by sacrificing pairing but by a constant interface. Third, the institutionalising of methodological generations: item-by-item comparison with P23F's ten methods, assertions growing across generations (13/13→50/50), defect-shape immunity passing between campaigns—the retrospective no longer a rite but an inheritable asset
unique_thinking: 它的思维方式的底色是'把知识体系当作一张需要同时满足密度与可靠性的网，把每一批入库当作对网的一次加载试验'：十个标志动作构成闭环。其一，'跨文明互文'——引用是探针，独特性隔着隔壁文明照出来；其二，'双语对生'——两种语言同刻受孕，互为质检；其三，'并行岗卡'——上下文隔离是质量装置而非仅效率装置；其四，'收官审计'——断言与合并同一事务周期，缺陷形态转化为永久断言的免疫记忆；其五，'悬空清零'——引用必可达，悬空按分型处置、等效替换优先于删除；其六，'场景锚定'——定义可能只是修辞，场景是模式的试车；其七，'载荷五件套'——接口恒定使合并退化为机械动作；其八，'语义全等快照'——哈希证形、逐字段证义，规范化重排以语义全等验证为通行证；其九，'漂移记账'——总数是移动视口，断言写相对、漂移记两笔；其十，'收官复盘'——把运转方法铸成可引用对象，且描述方法的作品必须通过它所描述的标准
unique_thinking_en: Its cognitive ground: the knowledge system as a web that must satisfy density and reliability at once, and every merge as a load test on that web—ten signature moves in a closed loop. First, cross-civilization intertext: the reference as probe, uniqueness lit from the neighbouring civilization. Second, bilingual co-genesis: two tongues conceived together, each the other's inspector. Third, parallel post-cards: context isolation as a quality device, not merely an efficiency one. Fourth, the closing audit: assertion and merge in one transaction cycle, defect shapes converting into permanent assertions—an immune memory. Fifth, dangling zeroing: every reference resolvable; dangling ones typed, semantic equivalents preferred to deletion. Sixth, scenario anchoring: a definition may be rhetoric—the scenario is the mode's road test. Seventh, the five-piece payload: a constant interface reduces merging to mechanics. Eighth, semantic-identity snapshots: hash proves shape, fields prove meaning; canonical reformatting travels on a verified passport. Ninth, the drift ledger: the total a moving viewport—assert relatively, book the drift twice. Tenth, the closing retrospective: the working method cast into a citable object, and the describing work must pass the standards it describes

modes.domain_zh: 知识挖掘方法论/把分属不同文明圈的人物放在同一张互文网络上挖掘——迈蒙尼德与苏莱曼同库、莲花生与奥罗宾多相邻、赫茨尔与顾颉刚互照：一位人物的独特性只有在'隔壁文明怎么处理同一问题'的对照中才真正显形，交叉引用不是装饰而是挖掘的探针
modes.domain_en: Knowledge-mining methodology / mining figures of different civilizations on one intertextual network—Maimonides shelved with Suleiman, Padmasambhava adjacent to Aurobindo, Herzl read against Gu Jiegang: a figure's uniqueness only shows shape against 'how the neighbouring civilization handled the same problem'; cross-references are not ornament but the probe of mining
modes.definition_zh: 知识挖掘方法论/跨文明互文法的核心命题是：单人物深挖的产出上限由'对照系'决定——只有一位人物时，其方法的独特性只能靠自我陈述；当主库同时容纳犹太、伊斯兰、印度、中国、欧洲、日本等文明圈的人物时，每一次挖掘都应主动寻找异文明的同构方法做对照系。Phase 21 的挖掘实践给出了三层操作：第一层，同问题对照——赫茨尔的'演说造国'与梁启超的'新民锻造'同答'如何凭观念造共同体'，挖掘赫茨尔时必须引出 M-LQC 而非只在注释里提一句；第二层，反向照明——奥罗宾多的'内卷演化'使莲花生'伏藏'的时间观从神秘叙事变为可分析的意识演化模型，后来者读莲花生的收获因奥罗宾多的存在而不同；第三层，网络效应入库——每条 cross_reference 都要让读者'顺着引用多读一位人物'，交叉引用密度是主库价值增长的非线性指标。这条方法的失败机制是'文明圈孤岛'：按文明分仓挖掘、各自闭环，最终得到的是 N 个互不相干的专题库而非一张知识网络
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-mining methodology: the core proposition is that the yield ceiling of mining one figure is set by the system of comparison—with a single figure, uniqueness rests on self-testimony; when the library holds Jewish, Islamic, Indian, Chinese, European and Japanese figures at once, every mining pass should actively seek a homologous method in an alien civilization as its frame of contrast. Phase 21 practice gives three operations. First, same-problem contrast: Herzl's nation-by-speech and Liang Qichao's forging of the new citizen answer the same question—how to make a community out of an idea—so mining Herzl must cite M-LQC, not merely name it in a note. Second, reverse illumination: Aurobindo's involution-evolution turns Padmasambhava's 'terma' from mystical narrative into an analysable model of the evolution of consciousness—the later reader of Padmasambhava gains something different because Aurobindo is in the library. Third, network effect on entry: each cross-reference should send the reader onward to one more figure; the density of cross-references is the non-linear index of the library's growth in value. The failure mode is the 'civilizational silo': mining by civilizational compartment, each closed in itself, ends in N unrelated topical collections rather than one web of knowledge

modes.key_quote_zh: 一位人物的独特性，是隔着隔壁文明照出来的——引用不是脚注，是探针。
modes.key_quote_en: A figure's uniqueness is lit from across the neighbouring civilization—a cross-reference is not a footnote but a probe.
key_concepts: 同问题对照 same-problem contrast（异文明人物回答同一问题时互为对照系）
figures of alien civilizations facing one problem serve as each other's frame of contrast
反向照明 reverse illumination（后入库人物改变先入库人物的可读性——网络效应回溯生效）
a later entry changes how an earlier one reads—the network effect works backwards
互文探针 the intertextual probe（交叉引用写成'值得顺读的论证'而非'顺带一提'）
cross-references written as arguments worth following, not asides
孤岛警报 silo alarm（连续多人物的引用全部落在同文明圈内即触发跨圈强制检索）
when a run of figures cites only its own civilization, a forced cross-circle search is triggered
process_zh: 划定问题域：为被挖掘人物提炼三个'根本问题'（如'共同体如何凭观念成立'）
跨圈检索：在主库中按问题而非按文明检索同构方法——检索词是问题不是人名
双向成文：对照引用写成双向论证——既用异邦方法照明本人物，也说明本人物反过来改变对异邦方法的读法
引用计数：每次挖掘至少产出一条跨文明 cross_reference——零跨圈引用的挖掘稿打回重挖
网络巡检：每十个家族入库后跑一次引用密度统计——密度不增即检查是否滑向孤岛化
process_en: Frame the questions: distil three 'root questions' for the figure under mining (e.g. how does a community come to be out of an idea)
Search across circles: query the library by problem, not by civilization—the search terms are questions, not names
Write both ways: compose the contrast as a two-way argument—the alien method lights this figure, and this figure changes how the alien method should be read
Count the references: every mining pass yields at least one cross-civilization cross-reference; a draft with zero is sent back
Patrol the web: after every ten families entered, run a density check on cross-references; flat density signals silo-formation
representative_cases_zh: 赫茨尔×梁启超互文（Phase 21）：H-HER-001 的'演说造国法/大会建制法'在入库时即与 M-LQC-001 新民锻造法、M-LQC-008 论战市场法互相引用——'凭写作与集会造共同体'的同一问题在犹太复国与中国新民两语境下各得一解
奥罗宾多×莲花生互文（Phase 21）：H-AUR-001 的内卷演化双程法使 H-PAD-001 的伏藏体系获得演化论读法——先入库的莲花生因后入库的奥罗宾多而变得'更可分析'
顾颉刚×王国维×司马光互文（Phase 21）：M-GJG-004 疑古辨伪法同时引 M-WGW-009 疑信互限法与 M-SMG-002 考异存真法——'疑'在三人手中是三种不同强度的工具，不对照则不可辨
representative_cases_en: Herzl × Liang Qichao (Phase 21): H-HER-001's speech-forges-a-nation and assembly-building methods cross-cite M-LQC-001 and M-LQC-008 at entry—the one question of making a community by writing and meeting answered in both the Zionist and the new-citizen contexts

Aurobindo × Padmasambhava (Phase 21): H-AUR-001's involution-evolution gives H-PAD-001's terma system an evolutionary reading—the earlier-entered Padmasambhava becomes 'more analysable' because of the later Aurobindo
Gu Jiegang × Wang Guowei × Sima Guang (Phase 21): M-GJG-004 cites both M-WGW-009 and M-SMG-002—'doubt' is a tool of three different strengths in three hands, indistinguishable without the contrast
modern_applications_zh: 跨国团队知识管理：把各国团队的'同问题解法'并排归档而非按国别分仓——巴西团队解决报价延迟的方案与德国团队的同类方案互设链接
产品竞品分析：竞品矩阵按'解决的用户问题'为轴而非按公司为轴——同轴并列才能暴露每家的独特取舍
个人学习系统：学任何新领域先问'我已会的哪个领域在回答同一问题'——用旧领域做新领域的对照系
modern_applications_en: Knowledge management in multinational teams: file each country team's solutions by problem, not by country—the Brazilian fix for quote latency linked beside the German fix for the same
Competitive analysis: axes of the competitor matrix are user problems served, not companies—only side-by-side on one axis do the distinctive trade-offs show
Personal learning: before any new field ask which field you already know answers the same question—let the old field be the new field's frame of contrast

modes.domain_zh: 知识生产方法论/每条知识在诞生时刻即以 zh/en 双语成对生成——不是先写中文再翻译，而是两个文本互为'对生胚'：中文稿的洞见强制英文稿重现，英文稿的精确强制中文稿消除歧义；10+10 场景逐对配对、逐对验收，双语不齐即视为半成品
modes.domain_en: Knowledge-production methodology / every item of knowledge born as a zh/en pair at the moment of creation—not Chinese first, then translated, but two texts as co-genetic twins: the Chinese draft's insights forced to reappear in English, the English draft's precision forced to de-ambiguate the Chinese; ten-plus-ten scenarios paired one-to-one, accepted pair by pair; a missing twin is a half-made artefact
modes.definition_zh: 知识生产方法论/双语对生法的核心命题是：翻译是事后工序时，知识就在翻译中失真一次；双语对生时，两种语言互为对方的质检员。Phase 21 每位人物产出 C-XXX-001~010 与 C-XXX-001E~010E 共 20 条场景，验收断言是'zh/en 10 对逐条配对且 text 非空'——配对不是数量检查而是语义检查：中文场景的推理链必须在英文场景中完整重现，英文场景的限定词（'the later the age'而非'later ages'）必须逼中文稿把'时代愈后'写成确定辖域。双语对生的深层收益是概念定影：一个模式名（层累造史法/Cumulative Fabrication Method）在两种语言中同时定名，迫使挖掘者在命名时就排除两种语言各自的含混——'法'字不可译时，英文名必须另铸术语而非勉强对译。失败机制是'译后补'：先中文后英文，英文沦为中文的影子，双语场景名存实亡
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-production methodology: the core proposition—when translation is an afterthought, knowledge is distorted once in translation; when languages are co-genetic, each is the other's inspector. Each Phase 21 figure yields twenty scenarios, C-XXX-001~010 and C-XXX-001E~010E, with the acceptance assertion 'zh/en ten pairs matched one-to-one and text non-empty'—matching is semantic, not arithmetic: the Chinese scenario's chain of reasoning must reappear whole in the English, and the English qualifier ('the later the age', not 'later ages') must force the Chinese to give '时代愈后' a determinate scope. The deeper yield is the fixing of concepts: a mode name (层累造史法/Cumulative Fabrication Method) is christened in two tongues at once, forcing the miner to expel each language's native ambiguities at naming time—when '法' resists translation, the English name must coin a term, not approximate. The failure mode is 'translated afterwards': Chinese first, English as its shadow, bilingual scenarios in name only
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 场景入库链（每份 merge_payload 的 10+10 双语场景与'zh/en 逐条配对'验收断言）；C-GJG-001/001E、C-WGW-003/003E 等成对样本
modes.key_quote_zh: 两种语言同时受孕——中文逼英文说清，英文逼中文说死。
modes.key_quote_en: Two tongues conceived together—the Chinese forces the English to be clear, the English forces the Chinese to be exact.
key_concepts: 对生胚 co-genetic twins（两语文本同刻生成、互为质检——翻译退居二线）
the two texts born together, each the other's inspector—translation demoted
语义配对 semantic pairing（验收对的是推理链重现而非字符数量）
acceptance checks the reappearance of the reasoning chain, not the character count
概念定影 concept fixing（模式名双语同时定名，逼出术语铸造而非勉译）
mode names christened in both tongues at once—coining terms instead of straining translation
半成品判定 the half-made rule（双语缺一即不合格品，不得入库）
a missing twin is a reject; nothing enters the library half-paired
process_zh: 同刻起草：中文场景与英文场景在同一工作会话内先后写成——间隔不超过一个工作单元
链路核对：逐条检查中文推理链在英文中是否完整重现——省略即缺陷
限定词反攻：以英文限定词回查中文表述的辖域——中文被逼着更精确即对生生效
术语铸名：模式名与核心概念双语同时定名——不可译处铸新词并双语注释
成对验收：验收断言写'10 对逐条配对'而非'zh 10 条 en 10 条'——配对失败整批退回
process_en: Draft together: write the Chinese and English scenarios within one working session—the gap no more than one work unit
Check the chain: verify the Chinese reasoning reappears whole in the English; omission is a defect
Qualifiers strike back: audit the Chinese scope against the English qualifiers—when Chinese is forced more precise, co-genesis is working
Coin the terms: fix mode names and key concepts in both tongues at once; where untranslatable, coin and gloss bilingually
Accept in pairs: the assertion reads 'ten pairs matched one-to-one', not 'ten zh and ten en'—failed pairing rejects the batch
representative_cases_zh: 顾颉刚 20 场景成对（Phase 21）：C-GJG-001 与 C-GJG-001E 同述'官网沿革层累图'案例——中文'底蕴最晚出现、每次融资后加一层'与英文“'heritage' appeared latest, one layer per funding round”逐层对应
王国维境界说双语定名：'境界说'与'the theory of jingjie（worlds wrought）'同时铸名——英文不取'realm'勉译而在括注中重铸概念
验收断言演进：从早期'各 10 条'的数量断言到 Phase 21 的'逐条配对且 text 非空'语义断言——双语质量标准本身在入库链中升级
representative_cases_en: Gu Jiegang's twenty scenarios paired (Phase 21): C-GJG-001 and C-GJG-001E tell one case—the stratified website history—layer by layer matched between Chinese and English
The bilingual christening of jingjie: '境界说' and 'the theory of jingjie (worlds wrought)' fixed together—English declines the strained 'realm' and recasts the concept in a gloss

The evolution of the acceptance assertion: from the early count ('ten each') to Phase 21's semantic assertion ('paired one-to-one, text non-empty')—the bilingual standard itself upgraded along the entry chain
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目文档：README 与 docs/ 同步双语维护，改中文必须同会话改英文——'文档双语漂移'在 PR 阶段拦截
跨国产品发布：营销文案中英同刻定稿，中文 slogan 的双关必须在英文中重铸而非注释——'translate later'模式废除
法律合同双语版本：中英文本逐条对生起草，任一语的限定词修改强制另一语同步——'以中文版为准'的单语霸权消除
modern_applications_en: Open-source documentation: README and docs maintained bilingually in step—every Chinese edit carries the English edit in the same PR, drift intercepted at review
Global product launches: marketing copy finalised in both tongues at once; a Chinese pun must be recast, not footnoted, in English—the 'translate later' model abolished
Bilingual contracts: clauses drafted zh/en as co-genetic pairs; a qualifier changed in one language forces the other—the hegemony of 'the Chinese version prevails' dissolved

modes.domain_zh: 协作组织方法论/大规模挖掘拆为多智能体并行岗卡：挖掘（serrano）、入库（elcano）、验收（espinosa）、归档（pigafetta）四岗各持独立任务卡、独立上下文、独立验收断言——岗位间只通过 merge_payload 与 QA 报告交接，上下文隔离使每岗只看见自己该看见的
modes.domain_en: Collaboration-organisation methodology / large-scale mining decomposed into parallel post-cards for multiple agents: mining (serrano), entry (elcano), acceptance (espinosa), archiving (pigafetta)—four posts, each with its own card, its own context, its own acceptance assertions; the posts hand over only through merge payloads and QA reports, and context isolation lets each post see only what it should
modes.definition_zh: 协作组织方法论/并行岗卡法的核心命题是：上下文隔离不是协作的成本而是质量的来源——入库者看不见挖掘者的推理过程，只看见载荷，因而只能机械合并、无力擅自改写；验收者看不见入库者的自述，只看见库内事实，因而独立抽检天然无偏见。Phase 21 的实践规格：每张卡以结构化 body 传递唯一必要的上下文（figure_name/figure_code/depends_on），岗间交接物是五件套载荷与 qa_postmerge 报告；并行度靠'库级区段预定'保证——十几个挖掘卡同时运行而不冲突，因为每张卡只动自己的 M-XXX 区段。这条方法与 P23F '四段流水线'的差别在粒度：流水线是工序串联，岗卡是并行调度——挖掘、入库、验收在 git log 上交叠推进，库总数随并行入库漂移，每张归档卡都注明'当前库 N 模式（随并行入库漂移核对）'。失败机制是上下文泄漏：入库者读到挖掘者的长篇论证后开始'顺手优化'，纯增量承诺即告失效
modes.definition_en: Collaboration-organisation methodology: the core proposition—context isolation is not the cost of collaboration but its source of quality: the entering agent, blind to the miner's reasoning and seeing only the payload, can only merge mechanically and cannot improvise edits; the verifying agent, blind to the entrant's self-report and seeing only facts in the library, spot-checks without bias by construction. Phase 21's specification: each card passes exactly the necessary context in a structured body (figure_name/figure_code/depends_on); the hand-over artefacts are the five-piece payload and the qa_postmerge report; parallelism is secured by library-level range reservation—a dozen mining cards run at once without collision because each touches only its own M-XXX range. The difference from P23F's four-stage pipeline is granularity: the pipeline strings operations in series, the post-card schedules them in parallel—mining, entry and acceptance overlap on the git log, the library count drifts with concurrent merges, and every archive card notes 'the current library of N modes (verified against the drifting baseline)'. The failure mode is context leakage: the entrant reads the miner's long argument and begins to 'improve in passing'—the pure-increment pledge dies
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 岗卡分工链（boards 仓任务卡与 git log 交叠记录）；各归档提交的'随并行入库漂移核对'注记；H-P23F-001 四段流水线法的粒度升级
modes.key_quote_zh: 每个岗位只该看见自己该看见的——看不见论证的人，才改不动论证。
modes.key_quote_en: Each post should see only what it must—one who cannot see the argument cannot tamper with it.
key_concepts: 上下文隔离 context isolation（岗位间只传载荷与报告，不传推理）
posts exchange payloads and reports, never reasoning
区段并行 range parallelism（每卡独占自己的编号区段——并行不冲突）
each card owns its ID range exclusively—parallel without collision
漂移注记 the drift note（归档时注明当前库总数——基线移动被显式承认）
archive notes the current library count—the moving baseline made explicit
泄漏警报 leakage alarm（入库提交出现'顺手优化'即违反岗卡纪律）
any 'improvement in passing' in an entry commit violates post discipline
process_zh: 拆卡定岗：按 figure 拆挖掘卡、按批次拆入库/验收/归档卡——每卡 body 只含结构化必要上下文
区段预定：每张挖掘卡声明自己的 M-XXX-001~010 区段——并行卡零冲突
载荷交接：岗位间只传 merge_payload 与 qa 报告——推理过程不过岗
漂移核对：每张卡记录开工与完工时的库总数——漂移量显式入档
越岗审计：入库提交若含非合并性改动即触发越岗警报——'顺手优化'按事故处理
process_en: Decompose and post: mining cards per figure, entry/acceptance/archive cards per batch—each body carrying only structured necessary context
Reserve ranges: every mining card declares its M-XXX-001~010 range—zero collisions across parallel cards
Hand over by payload: posts exchange merge payloads and QA reports—reasoning does not cross the post
Reconcile drift: every card records the library count at start and at finish—the drift amount explicitly filed
Audit crossing: any non-merge change in an entry commit raises the crossing alarm—'improvement in passing' treated as an incident
representative_cases_zh: Phase 21 并行入库实况：库总数在 H-SMG 入库卡（1412→1422）与 H-GJG 归档卡（'当前库 1452 模式'）之间随并行推进持续漂移——每卡各自核对漂移而互不阻塞
顾颉刚卡链（t_6008be16→t_78e8503a）：挖掘卡 body 只传 figure_name/figure_code/output_schema 三个字段——入库者 elcano 未见挖掘者任何论证文本
本田归档卡（t_267a26b9）：归档复检注明'归档复检逐项实测 (master HEAD 随并行入库漂移, 库 1412 模式, 本环节零数据改动)'——漂移核对成为归档标准段
representative_cases_en: Phase 21's concurrent entries live: the library count drifts from the SMG entry card (1412→1422) to the GJG archive card ('the current library, 1,452 modes')—each card reconciles its own drift and none blocks another
The Gu Jiegang card chain (t_6008be16→t_78e8503a): the mining card's body passes three fields—figure_name, figure_code, output_schema; the entrant elcano never sees a line of the miner's argument

The Honda archive card (t_267a26b9): its re-check notes 'measured against a master HEAD drifting with concurrent entries, 1,412 modes, zero data change in this stage'—drift reconciliation a standard section of archiving
modern_applications_zh: 微服务团队分工：服务边界即区段——每个团队只动自己服务的仓库，跨服务需求走显式 API 变更卡而非'顺手改邻居'
出版流水线：编辑只对稿件的'可合并性'负责，不见作者创作过程；审校只对事实负责，不见编辑的自述——岗位之间以稿面为唯一接口
大型开源项目：maintainer 只 review diff 不读 issue 长文——上下文最小化降低越权改写的诱惑
modern_applications_en: Microservice team boundaries: service edges are the ranges—one team touches only its own repos; cross-service needs go through an explicit API-change card, never 'a quick fix next door'

Publishing pipelines: the editor answers only for mergeability and never sees the author's process; the proofreader answers only for facts and never sees the editor's account—the page is the sole interface between posts
Large open source: maintainers review the diff without reading the long issue—minimal context lowers the temptation of unauthorised rewriting

modes.domain_zh: 质量方法论/每一批入库收尾时立即运行独立断言清单（qa_postmerge）：figure 内嵌与主库逐字段比对、双语场景逐条配对、scenario_tags 覆盖全部 mode_code、cross_references 逐条在库、related_modes 悬空为零——审计不是阶段末仪式而是每个事务的原子组成部分，17/17 PASS 是合并提交的前置条件
modes.domain_en: Quality methodology / the moment a batch finishes entry, an independent assertion list runs (qa_postmerge): the figure-embedded modes compared field-by-field with the library, bilingual scenarios paired one-to-one, scenario_tags covering every mode_code, cross-references each resolved in the library, related_modes with zero dangling—an audit not as a closing ceremony but as the atomic part of each transaction; 17/17 PASS is a precondition of the merge commit
modes.definition_zh: 质量方法论/收官审计法的核心命题是：审计与写入必须在同一个事务周期内完成——'先入库、后补验'把缺陷窗口从分钟拉长到天，且补验时基线已漂移、责任已稀释。Phase 21 的断言清单规格：每份 merge_payload 入库后同步产出 qa_postmerge_<code>.py，断言逐条可独立重跑（M-XXX-001~010 在主库且 id 唯一/figure 内嵌 10 模式与主库逐字段一致 0 mismatch/C-XXX zh/en 10 对逐条配对且 text 非空/scenario_tags 覆盖全部 10 mode_code/figure cross_references 全部在库/related_modes bare 悬空 0/era 生卒年合法）；断言数量随发现缺陷的形态增长（13/13→17/17→50/50）——每一个曾经的缺陷都会变成一条永久断言，这使审计清单成为'免疫记忆'：库被同一形态的缺陷伤害至多一次。失败机制是'抽样审计'：抽查 3 条通过即宣布合格，系统性缺陷恰好藏在未抽的 7 条里
modes.definition_en: Quality methodology: the core proposition—audit and write must complete within one transaction cycle; 'enter first, verify later' stretches the defect window from minutes to days, and by the time of the late check the baseline has drifted and responsibility has thinned. Phase 21's specification: with each merge payload the entry produces qa_postmerge_<code>.py, its assertions independently rerunnable—the ten modes present and ids unique; the figure-embedded ten identical field-by-field, zero mismatch; the bilingual scenarios paired one-to-one, text non-empty; scenario_tags covering all ten mode_codes; every cross-reference resolved in the library; related_modes dangling zero; era years lawful. The assertion count grows with the shapes of defects found (13/13→17/17→50/50)—every defect once suffered becomes a permanent assertion, making the audit list an immune memory: the library is wounded by any given defect shape at most once. The failure mode is 'sampling': spot-check three items, declare pass—and the systemic defect sits precisely in the seven unchecked
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 各入库提交附带的 qa_postmerge_* 断言清单（13/13、15/15、17/17、49/49、50/50 等）；验收脚本 T1-Tn 传统（verify_*_ingest.py 系列）
modes.key_quote_zh: 每个曾经的缺陷都会变成一条永久断言——库对同一形态的伤，至多受一次。
modes.key_quote_en: Every defect once suffered becomes a permanent assertion—the library takes any given wound at most once.
key_concepts: 事务内审计 in-transaction audit（验收是合并的前置条件而非事后补票）
acceptance as precondition of the merge, never an afterthought ticket
断言清单 the assertion list（逐条可独立重跑，PASS/FAIL 二值输出）
assertions rerunnable one by one, binary PASS/FAIL
免疫记忆 immune memory（缺陷形态→永久断言的转化机制）
the conversion of a defect shape into a permanent assertion
全量主义 the no-sampling rule（断言覆盖全部新增条目——抽查即漏洞）
assertions cover every added item—sampling is the loophole
process_zh: 清单固化：把上一批的全部缺陷形态固化为断言——清单只增不减
同步产出：qa_postmerge_<code>.py 与 merge 提交同一事务周期——先断言后提交
逐条重跑：每条断言可独立执行并输出二值结果——禁止'整体感觉良好'式结论
覆盖率核对：断言覆盖全部新增条目与全部引用目标——零抽样
清单归档：断言清单随提交入 git——审计历史可重放、可追责
process_en: Freeze the list: convert every defect shape of the previous batch into an assertion—the list only grows
Produce in step: qa_postmerge_<code>.py within the same transaction cycle as the merge—assert first, commit after
Rerun one by one: each assertion runs alone and prints a binary result—no verdicts of 'generally sound'
Check coverage: assertions cover every added item and every reference target—zero sampling
File the list: the assertion list committed with the merge—the audit's history replayable and attributable
representative_cases_zh: 顾颉刚入库 17/17（t_78e8503a）：七组断言全部二值通过——含'figure cross_references 8 条全部在库 (含 3 条自引用 M-GJG 入库后在库)'这类边界情形
本田入库 50/50（de95018）：断言数从早期 13 条增长到 50 条——每一个 Phase 21 前期缺陷（如 tags 排序不一致、中文名重复）都成了永久断言
司马光 tags 去重（t_e16a3b5f）：payload 80 条含 2 条重复 tuple，入库时去重为 78 条并在提交说明中显式记录——审计发现即修正留痕
representative_cases_en: Gu Jiegang's 17/17 (t_78e8503a): seven assertion groups all binary-pass—including edge cases such as '8 cross-references all in the library (three self-references to M-GJG, resolved after entry)'
Honda's 50/50 (de95018): assertions grown from thirteen to fifty—every early Phase 21 defect (tag-order mismatch, duplicated Chinese names) now a permanent assertion
Sima Guang's tag dedup (t_e16a3b5f): the payload's 80 tags held 2 duplicate tuples; entry deduplicated to 78 and recorded the change explicitly in the commit—an audit finding fixed with a paper trail
modern_applications_zh: 支付系统对账：每笔交易落库即刻跑对账断言而非日终批量对账——缺陷窗口从 24 小时缩到秒级
CI/CD 门禁：部署前断言清单全量执行，任一 FAIL 阻断合并——'先上线后补测'废除
数据迁移验收：迁移脚本与校验脚本成对交付——'迁完再说'的迁移必然烂尾
modern_applications_en: Payment reconciliation: assertions run the moment a transaction lands, not in an end-of-day batch—the defect window shrinks from 24 hours to seconds
CI/CD gates: the full assertion list executes before deploy; any FAIL blocks the merge—'ship now, test later' abolished
Data-migration acceptance: migration and verification scripts delivered as a pair—any migration that says 'we will verify later' ends half-finished

modes.domain_zh: 知识网络方法论/related_modes、cross_references 与 scenario_tags 中的每一个引用目标都必须能在库内指认——引用悬空按缺陷而非按瑕疵处理；入库前占用检查、入库后逐条解析、发现悬空即定位（是上游虚构还是 id 演变）、修正留痕（提交说明显式列出每一处）
modes.domain_en: Data-quality methodology / every target of related_modes, cross_references and scenario_tags must be resolvable in the library—a dangling reference is a defect, not a blemish: occupancy checked before entry, each reference resolved after, any dangling one traced to its cause (upstream invention or id evolution) and fixed with a paper trail (every site listed in the commit message)
modes.definition_zh: 知识网络方法论/悬空清零法的核心命题是：知识网络的价值按'最弱引用'坍塌——一条悬空引用不只是死链接，它向读者许诺一个不存在的论证，是比缺失更糟的负资产。Phase 21 的悬空形态学：其一，上游虚构——挖掘者引用了想象中存在的模式（M-WGW-003 与 M-NOB-004 引用不存在的 M-DZS-001，实因董仲舒 Phase 20 用 legacy id M01~M10）；其二，演变脱节——库里条目换了 id，旧引用没跟上；其三，'注记式引用'——'M-HOB-001（霍布斯）'这类带注记的引用是库内既有惯例，解析时先剥离注记再查裸 id，并把这种容差显式写进审计断言（'bare 悬空 0'）。清零的纪律：入库时逐条解析全部 related_modes（跨人引用必查、自引用入库后复核）；修正必须'主库+figure 内嵌+双镜像'四处联动且在提交说明逐处列出。失败机制是'宽容入库'：'差不多指向那个意思'的引用被放行，网络的信任基础从此侵蚀
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-network methodology: the core proposition—the value of a knowledge web collapses at its weakest reference; one dangling reference is not a dead link but a promise of an argument that does not exist, worse than absence. Phase 21's morphology of the dangling: first, upstream invention—the miner cites a mode that exists only in imagination (M-WGW-003 and M-NOB-004 citing M-DZS-001, which does not exist because Dong Zhongshu's Phase 20 entries carry legacy ids M01~M10); second, evolutionary detachment—the library entry changed id and old references did not follow; third, the annotated reference—'M-HOB-001 (Hobbes)' is an established library convention, so resolution strips the annotation before checking the bare id, and this tolerance is written explicitly into the audit assertion ('bare dangling 0'). The discipline of zeroing: at entry, resolve every related_mode (cross-figure citations checked, self-references re-checked after entry); a fix must land in all four sites—library, embedded figure, both mirrors—each site listed in the commit. The failure mode is 'tolerant entry': a reference that 'roughly points at the idea' is admitted, and the web's trust erodes from that day
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 入库修正记录（t_f55e57ec 王国维批次对 M-WGW-003/M-NOB-004 的悬空引用修正；t_92655904 屠呦呦批次对 M-PAS-001 悬空引用的语义等效替换 M-BAK-007）；各 qa_postmerge 的'bare 悬空 0'断言
modes.key_quote_zh: 一条悬空引用是给读者的空头支票——兑付不了，就别开。
modes.key_quote_en: A dangling reference is a cheque the reader cannot cash—do not write it.
key_concepts: 最弱引用坍塌 weakest-link collapse（网络价值按最坏引用定级）
the web's value graded by its worst reference
悬空形态学 morphology of the dangling（虚构/脱节/注记三种成因分型处置）
three causes—invention, detachment, annotation—typed and handled differently
语义等效替换 semantic-equivalent substitution（悬空引用不删除而替换为库内在库的同义目标）
a dangling target replaced by an in-library equivalent, not merely deleted
四处联动 four-site linkage（修正覆盖主库/内嵌/双镜像并逐处留痕）
fixes land in library, embedded copy and both mirrors, site by site on record
process_zh: 入库前占用检查：引用目标在库内逐一指认——找不到即回上游修正
入库后全量解析：related_modes 逐条剥离注记、查裸 id——自引用入库后复核
悬空归因：分型'上游虚构/演变脱节/注记容差'——不同型不同处置
等效替换：优先替换为库内语义等效目标（如 M-PAS-001→M-BAK-007）而非一删了之
四处联动修正：主库、figure 内嵌、双镜像同步修——提交说明逐处列出
断言固化：'bare 悬空 0'写进 qa_postmerge——此形态缺陷永不复发
process_en: Pre-entry occupancy: resolve every reference target in the library; unfound ones go back upstream
Post-entry full resolution: strip annotations from every related_mode and check the bare id; self-references re-checked after entry
Attribute the dangling: type it—invention, detachment, or annotation tolerance—and handle by type
Substitute equivalently: prefer an in-library semantic equivalent (M-PAS-001→M-BAK-007) to mere deletion
Fix in four sites: library, embedded figure, both mirrors—each site listed in the commit
Freeze the assertion: 'bare dangling 0' written into qa_postmerge—this shape never recurs
representative_cases_zh: 王国维批次修正（t_f55e57ec）：M-WGW-003 与 M-NOB-004 引用不存在的 M-DZS-001——入库者定位根因（董仲舒为 legacy id）后移除悬空引用，提交说明显式记录'相对上游仅此修正'
屠呦呦批次替换（t_92655904）：figure cross_references 第 4 条 M-PAS-001（巴斯德）库内无此人——修正为 M-BAK-007 判例实验法（鹅颈瓶 1861 即其代表案例），语义等效而非删除
斯宾诺莎注记容差（t_34625574）：M-HOB-001 带注记引用沿用库内既有惯例（基线 M-LOC-003 同款 35 处）——审计断言写成'bare 悬空 0'以承认合法注记形态
representative_cases_en: The Wang Guowei fix (t_f55e57ec): M-WGW-003 and M-NOB-004 cite the nonexistent M-DZS-001—the entrant roots the cause (Dong Zhongshu's legacy ids), removes the dangling citations, and records 'the only correction against upstream' in the commit

The Tu Youyou substitution (t_92655904): cross-reference four, M-PAS-001 (Pasteur), has no such figure in the library—replaced by M-BAK-007, the method of the exemplary experiment (the swan-neck flask of 1861 its representative case), a semantic equivalent rather than a deletion

Spinoza's annotation tolerance (t_34625574): the annotated M-HOB-001 follows an established library convention (the M-LOC-003 baseline, 35 such); the audit asserts 'bare dangling 0' to admit the legal annotated form
modern_applications_zh: 代码库依赖治理：依赖版本升级时全量解析 import——悬空 import 在 CI 阶段即报错，'先合并后修'禁止
维基百科红链管理：红链不是允许堆积的债务而是待办工单——每月清零一次或转为显式'待建条目'清单

modern_applications_en: Dependency governance in code: resolve every import on version bump—dangling imports fail CI; 'merge now, fix later' forbidden
Red-link management on wikis: a red link is a work ticket, not an accumulating debt—zeroed monthly or converted to an explicit 'article wanted' list
Enterprise knowledge graphs: after entity disambiguation rewrite all old references—'old names in old documents' handled as defect tickets, not tolerated as legacy

modes.domain_zh: 知识验证方法论/每个思维模式必须锚定 10 条现代场景（zh/en 各 5 半径）才允许入库——场景不是示例装饰而是模式的'可运行测试'：把模式的核心判据放进一个当代决策情境，看它是否真能产出行动指令；写不出可执行场景的模式按'定义空转'退回
modes.domain_en: Knowledge-verification methodology / every thinking mode must anchor ten modern scenarios (five radii in each of zh and en) before it may enter the library—the scenario is not illustrative garnish but the mode's runnable test: put the mode's core criteria into a contemporary decision situation and see whether it truly yields a course of action; a mode that cannot generate an executable scenario is returned as 'a definition that idles'
modes.definition_zh: 知识验证方法论/场景锚定法的核心命题是：定义的完备性不可验证，场景的可执行性可以验证——一个模式若只能被复述而不能被'运行'（放进情境产出决策），它就只是修辞。Phase 21 的场景规格：每模式 2 条 zh 场景 + 2 条 en 场景（20 条/人物），每条场景必须含四要素——具体主体（CTO/主治医师/供应链总监）、真实张力（数据互相矛盾/时间窗只有 48 小时）、模式的判据被显式调用（'按年份排成地层'）、行动与后果（董事会要求回滚到有据可查的版本）。判据调用的显式性是关键：场景里必须能指认出'模式的哪条 process 步骤正在被执行'，否则场景与模式只是押韵。这条方法与'举例说明'的本质区别在于可证伪性：例子可以与定义同义反复，场景必须让模式承担做出具体决策的风险——决策错了说明模式在该情境失效，这本身就是反哺挖掘的信号
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-verification methodology: the core proposition—the completeness of a definition cannot be verified, but the executability of a scenario can; a mode that can only be recited, not 'run' (set into a situation to yield a decision), is rhetoric. Phase 21's scenario spec: two zh and two en scenarios per mode (twenty per figure), each containing four elements—a concrete subject (the CTO, the attending physician, the supply-chain director); a real tension (data contradict each other, the window is forty-eight hours); the mode's criteria explicitly invoked ('arrange the versions by year as strata'); an action with consequences (the board orders the page rolled back to the evidenced version). Explicit invocation is the crux: one must be able to point at which process step of the mode is being executed inside the scenario, else scenario and mode merely rhyme. The essential difference from 'giving an example' is falsifiability: an example may tautologically mirror the definition, but a scenario makes the mode bear the risk of deciding—and a wrong decision shows the mode failing in that context, itself a signal fed back into mining
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 各 merge_payload 的 20 条双语场景（C-XXX-001~010/E）；每份场景的'主体-张力-判据-后果'四要素结构；'zh/en 逐条配对且 text 非空'验收断言
modes.key_quote_zh: 定义可能只是修辞——场景才是模式的试车：发动得了，才许入库。
modes.key_quote_en: A definition may be mere rhetoric—the scenario is the mode's road test: it must start, or it does not enter.
key_concepts: 可运行测试 the runnable test（场景让模式产出决策而非复述）
the scenario makes the mode yield a decision, not a recitation
四要素规格 the four-element spec（主体/张力/判据显式调用/行动后果）
subject, tension, explicit invocation of criteria, action with consequences
可证伪性 falsifiability（场景逼模式承担决策风险——失败信号反哺挖掘）
scenarios make the mode bear decision risk—failure signals feed mining
押韵警报 the rhyme alarm（场景与定义同义反复即打回——例子不是测试）
a scenario that tautologically mirrors the definition goes back—an example is not a test
process_zh: 选张力：为模式找一个其判据真正改变决策的当代情境——判据在场与否结论不同的情境
定主体：具体到职务与处境（不是'一家公司'而是'刚接手数据事故的 CTO'）
显式调用：场景文本中可指认模式 process 的某一步正在执行——写成动作而非口号
写后果：行动有代价与结果——决策被证明对或错，场景才有信息量
对生配对：zh/en 同刻成稿、推理链互查——配对断言把'英文版偷工'拦在入库前
失效回灌：场景中模式失灵的案例单独登记——回灌给挖掘岗修订判据
process_en: Pick the tension: find a contemporary situation where the mode's criteria genuinely change the decision—where their presence or absence flips the outcome
Fix the subject: concrete in role and predicament—not 'a company' but 'the CTO who just inherited a data incident'
Invoke explicitly: the scenario text shows one process step of the mode being executed—an action, not a slogan
Write the consequence: actions carry cost and outcome—only decided-and-consequenced scenarios carry information
Pair co-genetically: zh and en drafted together, chains cross-checked; the pairing assertion blocks a shirking English version before entry
Feed failures back: scenarios where the mode fails are logged separately and returned to mining for criterion revision
representative_cases_zh: 顾颉刚层累法场景（C-GJG-001）：SaaS 公司官网沿革页的'三十年底蕴'——模式的'按年份排成地层'步骤被 CTO 显式执行，后果是董事会要求回滚——判据在场直接改变了决策
王国维二重证据法场景：尽调中纸面财务与系统流水矛盾——'纸面+地下'双证据互补的判据被写成具体的核对动作，而非'要交叉验证'的口号
本田三现主义场景：新任厂长被要求'现场、现物、现实'三步走——场景让方法承担'48 小时内找到真因'的决策风险，失败即停线损失
representative_cases_en: The cumulative-fabrication scenario (C-GJG-001): a website history page grown to 'three decades of heritage'—the stratify-by-year step explicitly executed by the CTO, the consequence a board-ordered rollback—the criteria present, the decision changed

A dual-evidence scenario for Wang Guowei: paper financials against system logs in due diligence—the complementarity of document and ground written as concrete cross-checks, not the slogan 'verify independently'

A three-reality scenario for Honda: the new plant head ordered through site, thing and fact—the method made to bear the decision risk of finding the true cause in forty-eight hours, failure meaning line-down losses
modern_applications_zh: 课程设计：每个理论配'决策演练'而非'案例分析'——学员必须用理论产出具体行动，答错有代价
产品需求验收：每条需求附'验收场景'（谁在什么张力下用它完成什么）——写不出场景的需求按空转需求砍掉
管理培训：方法论课程期末考'情境决策'而非'复述定义'——考的就是模式的可运行性
modern_applications_en: Curriculum design: every theory paired with a decision drill, not a case study—students must produce concrete action with the theory, and wrong answers cost
Product-requirement acceptance: each requirement carries an acceptance scenario (who, under what tension, accomplishing what)—requirements that cannot generate one are cut as idling
Management training: examined by situational decision, not recitation—the runnability of the method is the test

modes.domain_zh: 数据工程方法论/岗位间的一切知识移交收敛为标准载荷五件套——figure JSON（含内嵌 10 模式）、10+10 双语场景、scenario_tags、code_maps 条目、qa 断言清单——交接物的形态唯一化使合并退化为机械动作；载荷外的东西一律不过岗
modes.domain_en: Data-engineering methodology / all knowledge hand-over between posts converges on a standard five-piece payload—the figure JSON (with ten modes embedded), the ten-plus-ten bilingual scenarios, scenario_tags, the code_maps entry, the QA assertion list—unique shape of the hand-over makes the merge a mechanical act; anything beyond the payload does not cross the post
modes.definition_zh: 数据工程方法论/载荷五件套法的核心命题是：接口越窄，协作越稳——交接物形态的唯一性消灭了'理解成本'，使高节奏并行成为可能。五件套各自封口：figure JSON 是自足的（内嵌 10 模式使其可独立抽检）；场景是成对的（10+10 配对断言）；标签是覆盖的（scenario_tags 覆盖全部 10 mode_code）；登记是完备的（code_maps 条目含 mode_ids/tags/cross_references 三索引）；验收是可重跑的（qa_postmerge 断言清单随载荷同行）。Phase 21 的节奏数据：每 8-12 分钟一批入库，库从 1282 涨到 1452——节奏之所以不被质量拖垮，正因为入库者面对的是形态恒定的载荷而非'每批不同的材料'。失败机制是'载荷膨胀'：交接物里混进解释性长文、临时备注、未决问题——接口一旦有弹性，合并就重新变成需要判断的创造性劳动，纯增量承诺随之瓦解
modes.definition_en: Data-engineering methodology: the core proposition—the narrower the interface, the steadier the collaboration; uniqueness of the hand-over's shape abolishes comprehension cost and makes high-tempo parallelism possible. Each piece seals itself: the figure JSON is self-sufficient (ten modes embedded, independently checkable); the scenarios are paired (the 10+10 pairing assertion); the tags are covering (scenario_tags over all ten mode_codes); the registry complete (the code_maps entry with its three indices—mode_ids, tags, cross_references); the acceptance rerunnable (the qa_postmerge list travels with the payload). Phase 21's tempo: a batch merged every eight to twelve minutes, the library rising from 1,282 to 1,452—the tempo survives only because the entrant faces a payload of constant shape, not 'different material each batch'. The failure mode is payload bloat: explanatory essays, scratch notes, open questions mixing into the hand-over—once the interface gains elasticity, merging becomes creative judgement again, and the pure-increment pledge dissolves with it
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 各 merge_payload 文件（210KB 级、结构恒定）；merge_payload 规范（figure/scenarios zh+en/scenario_tags/code_maps_entry 五件套的载荷结构约定）；8-12 分钟一批的入库节奏（git log 时间戳序列）
modes.key_quote_zh: 接口恒定，节奏才敢快——合并应该是机械动作，判断留给验收。
modes.key_quote_en: Only a constant interface dares move fast—merging should be mechanical; judgement belongs to acceptance.
key_concepts: 形态唯一 shape uniqueness（交接物只有一种合法形态）
one lawful shape for the hand-over
各件封口 each piece seals itself（figure 自足/场景成对/标签覆盖/登记完备/验收重跑）
self-sufficient figure, paired scenarios, covering tags, complete registry, rerunnable acceptance
节奏不变量 the tempo invariant（载荷形态恒定使 8-12 分钟一批的节奏可持续）
constant payload shape sustains a batch every eight to twelve minutes
膨胀警报 bloat alarm（载荷内出现解释性长文即违反接口纪律）
any explanatory essay inside the payload breaches interface discipline
process_zh: 定板：把五件套的字段清单固化为模板——新增字段走显式的规范修订而非当场加塞
自足打包：figure JSON 内嵌全部 10 模式——载荷可独立抽检，不依赖库现场
成对入包：双语场景 10+10 与标签覆盖断言随载荷同行——不合格载荷到不了入库岗
机械合并：入库者只执行'追加'——四类文件各按区段追加，无一行改写
同行验收：qa_postmerge 断言清单与载荷同事务周期——验收不是下一班岗的事
规范演进：五件套本身若需升级（如场景从 20 条到 40 条），先改规范再改载荷——载荷永不先于规范变化
process_en: Freeze the board: fix the field lists of the five pieces as a template; new fields go through explicit spec revision, never improvised
Pack self-sufficient: the figure JSON embeds all ten modes—the payload checkable apart from the live library
Pair within the pack: the 10+10 scenarios and the tag-coverage assertions travel with the payload; a failing payload never reaches the entry post
Merge mechanically: the entrant only appends—four file classes each by range, not one line rewritten
Accept in step: the qa_postmerge list in the same transaction cycle as the payload—acceptance is not the next shift's job
Evolve by spec: if the five pieces need upgrading (say, scenarios from twenty to forty), revise the spec first, the payload after—the payload never precedes the spec
representative_cases_zh: 顾颉刚载荷（t_6008be16，210,643 字节，sha256 43714245）：五件套一次成型——figure（含内嵌 10 模式+双语 era）+20 场景+80 标签+code_maps 条目+qa 清单，入库复检 17/17 PASS
王国维载荷修正（t_f55e57ec）：上游载荷唯一缺陷（悬空引用）在入库前定位——修正范围严格限于载荷内容本身，五件套结构零改动
入库节奏实测：从 H-PAD（库 1282）到 H-GJG（库 1452）的 170 模式、17 批入库全部沿用同一载荷形态——节奏与形态的相互锁定
representative_cases_en: The Gu Jiegang payload (t_6008be16, 210,643 bytes, sha256 43714245): five pieces in one pass—figure (ten modes embedded, bilingual era), twenty scenarios, eighty tags, the code_maps entry, the QA list; post-merge re-check 17/17
The Wang Guowei correction (t_f55e57ec): the upstream payload's sole defect (a dangling reference) located before entry—the fix confined to payload content, the five-piece structure untouched
Tempo measured: from H-PAD (library 1,282) to H-GJG (1,452), 170 modes across seventeen merges, all in the same payload shape—tempo and shape locking each other

modes.domain_zh: 数据治理方法论/每次入库同时产出两级一致性证明——字节级（入库态 sha256 与上游载荷比对）与语义级（figure 内嵌与主库逐字段 0 mismatch）——允许'规范化重排'（如上游非规范缩进被规范化）当且仅当语义全等被独立验证；快照既是备份也是证据
modes.domain_en: Data-governance methodology / each entry yields two levels of consistency proof—byte-level (the entered sha256 against the upstream payload) and semantic-level (figure-embedded versus library, field-by-field, zero mismatch)—permitting 'canonical reformatting' (an upstream file's non-canonical indentation normalised) if and only if semantic identity is independently verified; the snapshot is at once backup and evidence
modes.definition_zh: 数据治理方法论/语义全等快照法的核心命题是：'一致'有两个强度——字节一致与语义一致，治理必须显式声明自己要求哪一种，且两种之间的每一次转换都要留证。Phase 21 的实践：上游载荷 sha256（43714245 等）与入库态 figure sha256（dfd4039e 等）分别记录在提交说明中；当入库形态与上游逐字节不同（南丁格尔批次上游为非规范缩进，入库时规范化）时，提交说明必须写明'语义全等已验证后规范化'——字节变化被显式解释为投影而非偷改。快照的双职能：merge_payload 文件本身就是上游语义的完整快照（210KB），备份目录 data/backup_merge_H-XXX-001_<ts> 是入库前库态快照——两个快照使任何一次合并都可在'上游-入库前-入库后'三点间做三角度量。失败机制是'哈希崇拜'：只记录 sha256 而不做语义逐字段比对，规范化重排就成了掩盖内容篡改的完美外衣
modes.definition_en: Data-governance methodology: the core proposition—'consistency' has two strengths, byte-level and semantic-level; governance must declare explicitly which it demands, and every conversion between the two must leave evidence. Phase 21's practice: the upstream payload's sha256 (43714245 and so on) and the entered figure's sha256 (dfd4039e and so on) each recorded in the commit message; where the entered form differs byte-by-byte from upstream (the Nightingale batch's upstream file carried non-canonical indentation, normalised at entry), the commit must state 'normalised after semantic identity was verified'—the byte change explained explicitly as projection, not tampering. The snapshot's double duty: the merge_payload file is itself a complete snapshot of upstream semantics (210KB), and the backup directory data/backup_merge_H-XXX-001_<ts> snapshots the library before entry—together they let any merge be measured three ways across 'upstream, before, after'. The failure mode is hash worship: recording sha256 without field-by-field semantic comparison turns canonical reformatting into a perfect cloak for content tampering
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 各入库提交的双 sha256 记录（上游载荷 43714245/a73134f7/e46d522c 与入库态 dfd4039e/2239890b 等）；南丁格尔批次'语义全等已验证后规范化'注记（t_79ae32ba）；备份目录 data/backup_merge_* 系列
modes.key_quote_zh: 哈希只证形同，逐字段才证义同——规范化重排的通行证，是语义全等的独立验证。
modes.key_quote_en: A hash proves the shape; field-by-field proves the meaning—the passport of canonical reformatting is independent verification of semantic identity.
key_concepts: 双级一致 two strengths of consistency（字节级与语义级分别声明、分别验证）
byte-level and semantic-level declared and verified separately
转换留证 evidence at conversion（每次规范化重排附'语义全等已验证'注记）
every canonical reformatting carries the 'semantic identity verified' note
三点度量 three-point measurement（上游/入库前/入库后三快照支撑任意追溯）
upstream, before, after—three snapshots backing any trace
哈希崇拜警示 the hash-worship warning（只比哈希不比字段=给篡改发外衣）
hash without fields is a cloak for tampering
process_zh: 双哈希入账：上游载荷与入库态各记 sha256——形同形异先分清
形异必注：字节不一致处逐条归因（缩进/键序/编码）——'语义全等已验证后规范化'为唯一合法注记
逐字段比对：figure 内嵌 10 模式与主库对应条目 24 字段逐一相等——0 mismatch 为唯一合格态
三快照留存：上游载荷文件、入库前备份目录、入库后提交——合并可三角度量
备份命名规范：data/backup_merge_H-XXX-001_<时间戳>——快照可按人物按时刻双维检索
process_en: Enter both hashes: upstream payload and entered state each sha256-recorded—shape-same or shape-different settled first
Annotate every difference: each byte-level difference attributed (indentation, key order, encoding)—'normalised after semantic identity verified' is the sole lawful note
Compare field by field: the figure-embedded ten against the library's entries, all twenty-four fields equal—zero mismatch the only passing state
Keep three snapshots: the upstream payload file, the pre-entry backup, the post-entry commit—any merge measurable from three angles
Name backups by rule: data/backup_merge_H-XXX-001_<timestamp>—snapshots retrievable by figure and by moment
representative_cases_zh: 顾颉刚双哈希（t_78e8503a）：上游 43714245、入库态 dfd4039e、'语义与上游全等'三句并存于同一提交说明——双级一致在提交说明里即完成声明
南丁格尔规范化（t_79ae32ba）：上游 f3174802 为非规范缩进——入库时规范化，提交说明写明'语义全等已验证后规范化'，figure 内嵌与主库 0 mismatch
屠呦呦语义等效（t_92655904）：悬空引用修正导致与上游不逐字节一致——以'语义等效替换'注记与备份目录共同留证，三快照支撑追溯
representative_cases_en: Gu Jiegang's twin hashes (t_78e8503a): upstream 43714245, entered dfd4039e, and 'semantically identical to upstream'—three claims cohabiting one commit message

The Nightingale normalisation (t_79ae32ba): upstream f3174802 carried non-canonical indentation—normalised at entry, the commit stating 'normalised after semantic identity was verified', embedded versus library zero mismatch

Tu Youyou's semantic equivalence (t_92655904): the dangling-reference fix broke byte identity with upstream—the 'semantic-equivalent substitution' note and the backup directory jointly leave the evidence, three snapshots backing the trace
modern_applications_zh: 数据库迁移：结构重排（表重构/键改名）必须附'数据语义全等'断言报告——只有行数对不上没有语义断言的迁移报告不可信
设计交付：Figma 重排图层后导出 CSS——视觉全等靠像素 diff 验证而非'看起来一样'
法务文本改版：条款重编号必须附'引用更新对照表'——编号变了而引用未跟即语义悬空
modern_applications_en: Database migration: structural reshuffles (table rework, key renames) must carry a semantic-identity assertion report; a migration report with counts but no semantic assertions is untrustworthy
Design hand-off: layers rearranged in Figma, CSS re-exported—visual identity proven by pixel diff, never by 'it looks the same'
Legal text revision: renumbered clauses must carry a cross-reference update table—new numbers with unfollowed references are dangling semantics

modes.domain_zh: 协作组织方法论/并行工程中共享基线必然移动——每张任务卡在开工与完工两个时刻各记一次库总数，漂移量显式入档（'随并行入库漂移核对'），验收断言写成相对断言（本批 10 模式在库且唯一）而非绝对断言（库总数等于 N）——把'基线在动'从混乱来源变成可审计的事实
modes.domain_en: Collaboration-organisation methodology / in parallel work the shared baseline necessarily moves—every task card records the library count at start and at finish, the drift explicitly filed ('reconciled against the drifting baseline of concurrent entries'), and acceptance assertions phrased relatively (these ten modes present and unique) rather than absolutely (the library totals N)—turning 'the baseline moves' from a source of chaos into an auditable fact
modes.definition_zh: 协作组织方法论/漂移记账法的核心命题是：并行系统里'总数'不是一个稳定事实而是一个移动视口——把它当稳定事实的团队会被假警报淹没（验收脚本发现'库总数不对！'而真相只是隔壁批次刚入库），把它当移动视口的团队则获得两种能力：相对断言（'本批在库且唯一'）在任何并行度下都稳定为真；漂移记录（开工 1432→完工 1452）事后可重构任意时刻的库态。Phase 21 的操作化：每张入库卡与归档卡显式写'当前库 N 模式'，归档卡再注'随并行入库漂移核对'——这不是免责声明而是测量协议；qa_postmerge 断言全部写成相对形式（M-GJG-001~010 在主库且 id 唯一），没有一个断言依赖库总数。这条方法与竺可桢账本自治的关系是深化而非重复：账本自治假设单一记账者逐日对账，漂移记账处理多记账者同时记账——账本本身成了并行对象。失败机制是'绝对断言依赖'：验收脚本里写死库总数，并行度一上来，明明合格的批次被假 FAIL 淹没
modes.definition_en: Collaboration-organisation methodology: the core proposition—in a parallel system the 'total' is not a stable fact but a moving viewport; teams that treat it as stable drown in false alarms (an acceptance script cries 'library count wrong!' when the truth is merely a neighbouring batch's fresh entry), while teams that treat it as a viewport gain two powers: relative assertions ('these ten present and unique') hold true at any parallelism, and drift records (1,432 at start, 1,452 at finish) let any past moment's library state be reconstructed. Phase 21's operationalisation: every entry and archive card states 'the current library, N modes', the archive adding 'reconciled against the drifting baseline of concurrent entries'—not a disclaimer but a measurement protocol; every qa_postmerge assertion is relative (M-GJG-001~010 present and ids unique), none depending on the library total. The relation to Zhu Kezhen's self-governed ledger is deepening, not repetition: ledger self-governance assumes one bookkeeper reconciling daily; the drift ledger handles many bookkeepers writing at once—the ledger itself becomes the parallel object. The failure mode is absolute-assertion dependence: the acceptance script hard-codes the library total, and with parallelism comes a flood of false FAILs against perfectly sound batches
modes.source_chapter: Phase 21 各归档卡'随并行入库漂移核对'注记（t_267a26b9、t_2c89e09e、t_4d8f34dc 等）；各 qa_postmerge 断言的相对形式；并行入库的库总数时间序列（1282→1452）
modes.key_quote_zh: 总数是移动的视口不是稳定的事实——断言写相对，漂移记两笔。
modes.key_quote_en: The total is a moving viewport, not a stable fact—assert in relative form, book the drift twice.
key_concepts: 移动视口 the moving viewport（并行系统中库总数是观测而非常量）
the library total as observation, not constant
相对断言 relative assertions（'本批在库且唯一'——不依赖全局总数）
'this batch present and unique'—no dependence on the global count
双点记账 two-point booking（开工/完工各记一次总数——漂移量可重构）
count at start and finish—drift reconstructable
假警报免疫 false-alarm immunity（绝对断言的 FAIL 全部失去信息价值）
absolute assertions turn every FAIL into noise
process_zh: 开工记账：任务卡启动时记录基线（库总数/相关区段占用）
完工记账：收尾时再记一次——漂移量=完工值-开工值，显式写入提交或报告
相对化断言：验收断言只引用本批对象与唯一性——禁止引用全局总数
漂移归因：意外漂移（超出并行入库预期）才触发调查——预期内漂移静默通过
时点重构：需要历史库态时用两卡之间的漂移记录插值——不靠'记忆'靠账本
process_en: Book at start: the card records its baseline on launch (library count, range occupancy)
Book at finish: record again at close—drift = finish minus start, written explicitly into commit or report
Relativise assertions: acceptance references only this batch's objects and their uniqueness—global totals banned
Attribute drift: only unexpected drift (beyond the concurrent-entry forecast) triggers investigation; forecast drift passes silently
Reconstruct points in time: historical library states interpolated from the drift records between cards—from the ledger, not from memory
representative_cases_zh: 本田归档漂移核对（t_267a26b9）：'归档复检逐项实测 (master HEAD 随并行入库漂移, 库 1412 模式, 本环节零数据改动)'——开工与完工库数分立，漂移被显式承认而非解释
富兰克林(女)归档（t_3c3ba3aa）：'入库 HEAD 793d77f, RFR 范围核对, 库总数随并行入库漂移'——验收范围锚定在 RFR 区段而非全库
qa_postmerge 全系相对化：从 13/13 到 50/50 的全部断言无一条写死库总数——170 模式并行入库零假警报
representative_cases_en: Honda's archive reconciliation (t_267a26b9): 'measured against a master HEAD drifting with concurrent entries, 1,412 modes, zero data change in this stage'—start and finish counts distinct, drift acknowledged rather than explained away
Rosalind Franklin's archive (t_3c3ba3aa): 'entry HEAD 793d77f, RFR range checked, the library total drifting with concurrent entries'—acceptance anchored to the RFR range, not the whole library
qa_postmerge fully relativised: every assertion from 13/13 to 50/50 hard-codes no library total—170 modes in parallel, zero false alarms
modern_applications_zh: 多分支 CI：测试断言只测本分支 diff 影响面——'全库回归'在每日上百合并的组织里是假警报制造机
库存系统：多仓并行盘点用'本 SKU 在位且唯一'断言替代'总库存等于昨日'——并行盘点不再互相作废
财务月结：并行结账期'本主体凭证完整且勾稽'优先于'集团总数锁定'——相对断言让多法人并行关账
modern_applications_en: Multi-branch CI: tests assert only their branch's diff surface—full-suite regression in an organisation merging a hundred times a day is a false-alarm factory
Inventory systems: parallel stocktakes assert 'this SKU present and unique' instead of 'total equals yesterday's'—parallel counting no longer voids itself
Financial close: during parallel close, 'this entity's entries complete and reconciled' precedes 'group total locked'—relative assertions let multiple legal entities close at once

modes.domain_zh: 组织学习方法论/每一期工程收尾时把'这一期是怎么工作的'本身当作挖掘对象——Phase24 收尾整合即把 Phase 21 十七批入库所依赖的方法论铸成最后一批'模式'入库：方法论的自我入库使下一期的改进有据可依，而非依赖当事人的记忆与口传
modes.domain_en: Organisational-learning methodology / at each campaign's close, mine 'how this campaign worked' itself—Phase 24's final integration casts the methodology that carried Phase 21's seventeen merges into the library as the last batch of 'modes': a methodology entered into its own library gives the next campaign grounds for improvement, instead of leaving it to the participants' memory and word of mouth
modes.definition_zh: 组织学习方法论/收官复盘法的核心命题是：组织最重要的知识资产是'自己如何运转的方法'，而这恰恰是最少被正式记录的——它活在当事人的手感里，随人员更替蒸发。Phase 21 的复盘实践：不写'总结报告'（那是叙事），而是把运转方法拆解为可入库的模式（跨文明互文、双语对生、并行岗卡、收官审计、悬空清零、场景锚定、载荷五件套、语义全等快照、漂移记账、收官复盘十法），每个模式带完整的定义/流程/案例/现代应用——方法论从'经验'升格为'可引用对象'，后来者可以 reference 它、批评它、修订它。复盘的自反性结构值得注意：本轮入库所用的方法正是本轮入库的内容——这套描述本身必须经受它所描述的标准的检验（本份载荷同样走五件套、走双语对生、走悬空清零），做不到的复盘是自欺。失败机制是'叙事化复盘'：复盘写成故事与感想，没有可执行断言，下一期重复同一批坑
modes.definition_en: Organisational-learning methodology: the core proposition—an organisation's most valuable knowledge asset is 'how it itself runs', and precisely that is the least formally recorded: it lives in the participants' feel and evaporates with turnover. Phase 21's retrospective practice: not a 'summary report' (that is narrative) but the working method decomposed into enterable modes (cross-civilization intertext, bilingual co-genesis, parallel post-cards, closing audit, dangling zeroing, scenario anchoring, the five-piece payload, semantic-identity snapshots, the drift ledger, the closing retrospective—ten methods), each with full definition, process, cases and modern applications—methodology upgraded from 'experience' to a 'citable object' that successors can reference, criticise and revise. Note the reflexive structure: the method used by this entry is the content of this entry—the description must itself pass the standards it describes (this payload also goes through the five pieces, bilingual co-genesis, dangling zeroing); a retrospective that cannot is self-deception. The failure mode is the 'narrative retrospective': the close-out written as story and sentiment with no executable assertions, and the next campaign steps in the same holes
modes.source_chapter: H-P23F-001（Phase 23 收尾整合——本法的直接先例：把 Phase 21-23 整合方法论铸成十法入库）；H-P24F-001（本轮：Phase 21 收官的方法论自反入库）
modes.key_quote_zh: 复盘不是写感想——是把'我们怎么干活的'铸成可引用、可批评、可修订的对象。
modes.key_quote_en: A retrospective is not a diary—it casts 'how we worked' into an object that can be cited, criticised and revised.
key_concepts: 方法论入库 methodology as content（运转方法本身成为库内模式）
the working method itself becomes a library mode
自反检验 the reflexive test（描述方法的作品必须通过它所描述的标准）
the work describing the method must pass the standards it describes
可引用对象 the citable object（复盘产物可被 reference/批评/修订——经验升格）
the retrospective's product referenceable, criticisable, revisable—experience upgraded
叙事化警报 the narrative alarm（只有故事没有断言的复盘按未完成处理）
a retrospective of stories without assertions counts as unfinished
process_zh: 提取运转方法：收尾时列出本期实际生效的做法清单（不是'计划做的'而是'实际撑住质量的'）
模式化拆解：把每条做法拆成定义/流程/案例/失败机制四件——叙事拆成可执行结构
自反验收：本复盘产物自身走它所主张的全部质量断言（双语配对/悬空清零/载荷五件套）
先例对表：与上一期收官产出（P23F 十法）逐条对照——重复处标注'验证有效'，分歧处写明演化理由
入库沉淀：方法论模式走标准入库链入主库——下一期开工时即加载为工作上下文
process_en: Extract the working method: at close, list what actually held quality—not what was planned but what carried the load
Modularise: break each practice into definition, process, cases, failure mode—narrative cut into executable structure
Accept reflexively: the retrospective itself passes every assertion it advocates (bilingual pairing, dangling zeroing, the five-piece payload)
Table against precedent: compare item by item with the previous campaign's closing output (P23F's ten methods)—agreements marked 'verified effective', divergences carrying their reasons for evolution
Sink into the library: the methodology modes enter through the standard chain—the next campaign loads them as working context on day one
representative_cases_zh: P23F 先例（H-P23F-001）：Phase 21-23 的整合方法（纯增量/双镜像/悬空清零/验收先行等十法）铸成人物入库——本轮 P24F 与其逐条对照：纯增量并库法在本期仍验证有效，载荷五件套法从其'merge_payload 规范'演化而来
